The source cell repeats the Site 53 coordinates (sand dune, 53.7579 E) on the Site 52 saline-pan row, so the site module averaged Site 52 to a point between the two locations. Independent evidence places Site 52 at 20.82784 N,53.57835 E: the Trip 4 and Trip 5 field sheets record that point for Site 52; the Trip 3 OsmAnd track (website/frontend/public/tracks/2024-02-20.gpx in the empty-quarter repository) stops within 400 m of it from 16:23 to 16:30 on 20 February 2024, twelve minutes after the Site 51 stop at 16:09--16:13, and reaches the 53.7579 E point only at 06:04--06:10 on 21 February 2024, the recorded Site 53 visit; the Trip 1 route timing (Site 51 at 07:37, Site 52 at 08:02, Site 53 at 09:03) is consistent with the same ordering along the transect; and the Open-Meteo elevation at that point (87 m) equals the site_altitudes.tsv value for Site 52. Robert Hoehndorf flagged the Trip 1 and Trip 3 Site 52 coordinates for review on 2026-09-07.
